blocks.text: Four kinds of state stay apart: search criteria in the URL, cached offers keyed by searchId, the editable booking draft, and server-owned holds and reservations. LocalDateTime pairs a wall-clock time with its branch zone, and every amount arrives in minor units from an offer.

blocks.title: Booking identity rules
rows: Offers from an older search cannot be held
Price and class are a server snapshot
Retries reach the same hold instead of creating a second one
Confirmation spends exactly one live hold

blocks.title: Driver data stays minimal
blocks.text: The draft keeps only fields the booking needs. License numbers, date of birth and payment details go to the server or the payment provider at confirmation and never enter the URL, logs, analytics or cross-tab messages. Driver age stays a search input because the server prices surcharges from it.
